TetrisStill.description: The tetris mark at rest, every dot filled: the finished header's mark.

TetrisLabel.description: The label beside the mark: a shimmer, and on top a copy of the text the band crosses after the mark, on the same loop, so the light runs from the icon on through the word.

ShimmerLabel.description: The label shimmer alone (a band of ink passing through muted text), for the flappy header.

FlappySprite.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: label
props.description: The live label. Defaults to the `thinking` label ("Thinking…").

props.name: time
props.description: Elapsed time after the label, e.g. "1.2s".

props.name: indicator
props.description: The mark beside the label.

props.name: glimmer
props.description: The light that crosses the tetris mark and its label as rows clear: glimm's prism, or neutral.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected agent's id.

props.name: showDescription
props.description: Show the one-line description under each name. Turn it off once agents are familiar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Secondary under the composer, Tertiary inside dense toolbars.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the 28px trigger, xs the 24px one.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Adds a "New agent" action under the list.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Label for the create action. Defaults to the `newAgent` label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the trigger when nothing is selected. Defaults to the `chooseAgent` label.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, e.g. to show the menu open on a docs stage.

props.name: disablePortal
props.description: Render the menu in place instead of in a portal.

AgentMenuItem.description: One row of the menu, `DropdownMenu/Item`. Must sit inside the picker's radio group.

AgentPickerRow.description: A static menu row for state sheets and docs (no menu around it): the same look as a menu item, with `state` forced to default, hover or selected.

AgentAvatar.description: Initials on a Badge hue pair, round. 16px uses semibold 7/8, 20px semibold 9/10, as on the uiKit Avatar. These sizes have no type token, so they stay raw. `avatar="flappy"` draws the flappy bird instead, in the agent's tone.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of suggestion: "Email suggestion", "Next steps", "CRM update".

props.name: icon
props.description: A 14px icon or app logo before the kind.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right of the kind: avatars of the people it concerns, or a small Badge with the source.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, right-aligned: the alternative first, the primary action last.

AgentSuggestionQuote.description: The message the suggestion answers: who sent it and what they wrote, on component/agent-suggestion/quote-bg (bg/canvas in Light, bg/muted in Dark).

props.name: from
props.description: The sender's name.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A 20px Avatar.

AgentSuggestionMetric.description: A number against its limit: the value in Display/sm, its unit, and a 6px bar of how much is used.

props.name: value
props.description: As shown: "47 / 50".

props.name: used
props.description: With `max`, draws the bar.

AgentSuggestionDiff.description: Old text struck through on bg/muted, the new text in status/green below it.

AgentSuggestionChanges.description: Fields the agent will change: name, the old value struck through, an arrow and the new one.

props.name: icon
props.description: `false` hides the status icon; a node replaces it.

props.name: action
props.description: A Button or Link, or a few in a fragment.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; called when it is pressed.

StatusIcon.description: @internal The status glyphs from Figma (16px, 1.25 stroke), drawn in currentColor. Neutral uses the info glyph.

CloseIcon.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: action
props.type: { label: React.ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: The button after the message; with `href` it renders as a link.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `dismissAnnouncement` label.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks to the top or bottom edge of its scroll container.

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary`: action/primary/bg (the default). `inverse`: action/inverse/bg, near-black in light and near-white in dark. `default`: bg/card with border/subtle rules above and below, like a Banner.

props.name: background
props.description: `mesh` lays the Banner's glow over the bar: lighter on primary and inverse, coloured on default.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Now and then a soft band of light crosses the bar (off under reduced motion).

props.name: meta
props.description: Type and size, e.g. "PDF · 2.4 MB". Shown on `lg` only.

props.name: icon
props.description: File type icon. Defaults to the PDF icon.

props.name: shape
props.description: Rounded inside the composer and chat, Default inside cards and tables.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows the remove button. Leave it out once the message is sent.

props.name: preview
props.description: Content for the hover preview, usually an `<AttachmentPreview>`.

AttachmentGroup.description: AttachmentGroup: files wrap onto new rows at 576px, 4px apart.

AttachmentPreview.description: AttachmentPreview: 296 wide, bg/popover, border/subtle, radius-xl, shadcn md shadow. A header with the file, a 176px scrolling viewport with a fade at the bottom, a border/subtle divider and a footer that moves between pages or sheets and opens the file.

props.name: children
props.description: The first page or the first rows. Scrolls inside a fixed 176px viewport.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Left side of the footer: an `AttachmentPreviewPager` or `AttachmentPreviewSheets`.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `openItem` label.

AttachmentPreviewPager.description: Document footer: previous / next section and "Page 1 of 3".

AttachmentPreviewSheets.description: Spreadsheet footer: one tab per sheet; the current one is filled bg/muted.

FileIcon.description: File type icons from uiKit `icon`. They keep their own colours (library primitives), so they don't follow currentColor.

props.name: initials
props.description: One or two letters, or a count like "+3" at the end of a group.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: shown in a tooltip on hover and focus, and read by screen readers.

AvatarGroup.description: A row of avatars sharing one name tooltip. It opens after AVATAR_TOOLTIP_DELAY on the first person; while it's open, the next person gets it at once: it slides along the row (transform, 200 ms, ease-out) and its width eases to the new name, which fades in. It closes AVATAR_TOOLTIP_CLOSE after the pointer leaves the row, so the gaps between faces don't close it. Focus shows it at once, Escape and blur hide it.

props.name: side
props.description: Where the shared name tooltip sits.

props.name: action
props.description: One action, usually `<Button variant="secondary">`. Stretches across a sidebar banner.

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary`: action/primary/bg with action/primary/fg text; its mesh glows lighter on top.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Now and then a soft band of light crosses the banner (off under reduced motion).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Defaults to the `dismiss` label.

props.name: mesh
props.description: Replace the mesh images.

props.name: legend
props.type: { label: string; value?: string; note?: string }
props.description: The legend row under the plot.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value in the tooltip ("covers").

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Swap the bars without motion when the data changes, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: items
props.description: From the top level down; the last one is the current page.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Fold the middle into "…" when there are more items than this.

BulkActionBarRoot.description: The floating toolbar on its own: the parts go inside.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items are selected. The bar shows from 1 and hides at 0.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Empties the selection: the clear button and Escape call it.

props.name: position
props.description: `sticky` sits after the content and sticks to the bottom of the screen while its container scrolls past; `absolute` lays it over the container's bottom edge (give the container `position: relative` and `pb-16`).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the element that places the bar (sticky or absolute, centred).

BulkActionBarCount.description: "3 selected" with the clear button. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarSeparator.description: A thin rule between the count and the actions. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarAction.description: One action as a button in the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

BulkActionBarOverflow.description: The ⋯ button and its menu, for the actions that don't get a button. Other props, `ref` included, go to the ⋯ Button.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions in the menu, in order.

BulkActionBar.description: The bar from props: the count and clear, a rule, a button per action, then the ⋯ menu. Other props, `ref` included, go to the toolbar element.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, as buttons after the count.

props.name: overflow
props.description: More actions, in a ⋯ menu after the buttons.

props.name: attached
props.description: Join the buttons into one block.

ButtonGroupSeparator.description: A thin rule between sets of buttons in a loose (`attached={false}`) group or a toolbar.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (a link, say) with the button's styles instead of a `<button>`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: a Spinner takes the middle and the label and icons turn invisible but keep their room, so the button doesn't change width. Clicks (and Enter in a form) do nothing; the button keeps its focus and looks, with `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled` for screen readers.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows the close button.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Defaults to the `close` label.

ChartCard.description: The card every chart sits in: bg/card, 1px border-default, radius-2xl, 16px in and 16 between rows. Row one: the title (16/24 medium, text/default) and, when there are `periods`, a small Select for the period at the right. Row two: the KPI (text/xl semibold) with its change badge, and the range under it in text/muted, 2px apart; without a KPI the range sits 4px under the title. Then the chart. The card is a size container, so a chart can lay itself out wider from 560px (`@min-[560px]:`).

ChartLegendPill.description: chart/legendPill. - `outline`: an outline pill with no fill — 8px swatch, label, value 6 apart, 6 / 10 in. Active turns the ring border-strong. - `plain` (the Donut legend): no ring and no value, 6 / 8 in; active fills bg/hover, as plain controls do on hover. Dimmed fades the content to 45%, never the ground.

ChartTooltip.description: The chart tooltip pill with its pointer. Exported for custom charts. With `anchor` it floats over the page (see Floating): it never gets cut off by the card, flips below when there's no room above, slides in from the screen edge, and its pointer keeps pointing at the anchor. Without it, it renders in place.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element it points at.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the anchor and the pointer's tip.

ChartLegendRow.description: One legend row: 8px swatch, label, value and an optional note.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the text the box sits on.

ChipAvatar.description: The 16px initials avatar from Figma: tone-bg, 7px semibold tone-fg.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based, as in the Sources list.

props.name: defaultOpen

props.name: highlightLines

props.name: highlight

props.name: value

props.name: footer

props.name: placeholder

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The query field's placeholder and name. Defaults to the `search` label.

props.name: emptyText

props.name: applyLabel

props.name: cancelLabel

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `clear` label.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Toggle the menu with ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

props.name: placeholder

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; gets the query. Defaults to the `noResultsFor` label.

props.name: hints

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal blocks the page and shows the overlay; turn it off for inline previews.

props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

ContextMenuSub.description: A row that opens a submenu beside it (hover, →, or Enter). Other props, `ref` and `className` included, go to the submenu's panel (the Radix SubContent), not to the row.

ContextMenuSeparator.description: A 1px bg/muted rule between groups of rows.

props.name: children
props.description: What the site stores and why. Defaults to the `cookieNotice` label.

props.name: onCustomize
props.description: Shows Customize; open your settings from here.

props.name: acceptLabel

props.name: rejectLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `rejectAll` label.

props.name: customizeLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `customize` label.

props.name: floating
props.description: Fixed to the bottom of the viewport, centred, 16px up.

AvailabilityCalendar.description: The Calendar with each day's free slots: a dot, a tooltip and its name. Other props, `ref` included, go to Calendar's root.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free slots per day, keyed by ISO date ("2026-11-26"). 0 is a full day. A day left out has no slots and can't be picked.

props.name: fewSlots
props.description: At or below this many free slots a day reads as nearly full: its dot becomes a ring.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why a day without free slots can't be picked: its tooltip, read after its date. Defaults to "Fully booked" for a day listed with 0.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: More days that can't be picked, whatever their slots.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked day (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day picked at first (uncontrolled).

AvailabilityDatePicker.description: A DatePicker field whose calendar shows each day's free slots. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger button.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free slots per day, keyed by ISO date ("2026-11-26"). 0 is a full day. A day left out has no slots and can't be picked.

props.name: fewSlots
props.description: At or below this many free slots a day reads as nearly full: its dot becomes a ring.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why a day without free slots can't be picked: its tooltip, read after its date. Defaults to "Fully booked" for a day listed with 0.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: More days that can't be picked, whatever their slots.

CalendarDay.description: One day of the Calendar, to return from `renderDay`: the default day button, which picks, holds the arrow keys' focus and draws today, the pick and the range. Children replace the number, `aria-label` the full date as its name. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button, so a Tooltip can wrap it.

props.name: value
props.description: single: the picked day.

props.name: range
props.description: range: the picked range.

props.name: month
props.description: The first month shown. Defaults to the value's month, or today's.

props.name: months
props.description: Two months side by side (the range picker).

props.name: today
props.description: Today, for the dash. Defaults to now.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Days that can't be picked, on top of those outside `min`/`max` (weekends, booked days). Like those, they stay reachable with the arrow keys and are read as unavailable.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: Draws each day, for a mark, a name or a tooltip of your own. Return a `CalendarDay`, the default day button, so picking and the arrow keys keep working.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's (Sunday in en-US, Monday in pl-PL).

DatePickerPanel.description: The date picker's panel on its own, in place: the popover surface with the Calendar, month and year to pick, and the presets. Other props, `ref` included, go to the surface.

props.name: isDisabled

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: As on Calendar: days that can't be picked, besides those outside min/max.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts listed before the calendar: `[datePresets.today, datePresets.tomorrow]`. Picking one picks its day and closes.

props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

props.name: collisionPadding

props.name: children
props.type: (state: { side: FloatingSide arrowRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null> arrowStyle: React.CSSProperties }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Gets the side it ended up on and the pointer's props (ref and position).

props.name: name
props.description: Names the control and picks this field's message out of the Form's `errors`.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message. It replaces the description and marks the control invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required mark after the label and sets `required` on the control.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The id given to the control. Generated when left out.

RequiredMark.description: @internal The required mark from Figma (the `sparkle 2` glyph in _label), 6px, in the label colour.

FieldError.description: @internal A field's or a group's error: Figma's 14px warning circle and the message, in red.

FieldDescription.description: @internal A field's or a group's description, muted.

props.name: errors
props.description: Error messages by field `name`.

props.name: onSubmitValues
props.description: Called on submit with the form's values; the default submit (a page load) is prevented.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The link or name it previews. Rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: ms the pointer rests before it opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: ms after the pointer leaves before it closes.

InputGroupAddon.description: A boxed segment of an InputGroup: text (`https://`, `€`), an icon, or a Kbd.

props.name: length
props.description: How many characters.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Cells per group; groups are split by a dash. 0 for one group.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Every cell is filled.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Which characters are allowed. Digits by default.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the cells invalid without one.

props.name: success
props.description: The code checked out: a message under the cells (replaces the hint), or `true` for green cells alone. Ignored while there is an error.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Shows "Didn’t get it?" with a resend under the cells, open after `resendAfter` seconds. Return a promise to show a spinner until the code is sent.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: Seconds before the code can be sent again, counted from when the field appears and from each resend.

props.name: suggestion
props.description: A code that arrived by text or email, offered in a popover under the cells; choosing it fills them.

props.name: suggestionFrom
props.description: Where the suggested code came from, after it in the popover. Defaults to the `fromMessages` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: leadingText
props.description: Muted text inside the field before the value: `$`, `https://`.

props.name: trailingText
props.description: Muted text inside the field after the value: `USD`, `.satin.dev`, a counter.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

KbdGroup.description: The keys of one shortcut, 2px apart.

props.name: keys
props.description: A shortcut such as "⌘K" or "⌃⇧V", split into keys, or the keys themselves.

KbdHint.description: A key hint for a menu footer: keys, then what they do in 12px text/muted, 6px apart.

props.name: labels
props.description: The words to change; the rest stay as they are (from a parent SatinLabels, or English).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value in the tooltip ("orders").

props.name: area
props.description: Fill under the line. `AreaCard` sets it.

props.name: labelEvery
props.description: Show every nth x label, counted back from the last point (3 for every third month of a year). Left out, about seven labels spread across the plot (five when they are dates).

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Swap the plot without the fade when the data changes, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

AreaCard.description: The Line chart with the gradient under its line.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph shown in a muted tile.

props.name: media
props.description: Shown as is, in place of the tile: an Avatar, an image.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target, e.g. `_blank`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` draws a card border, for a row on its own. Rows in a List take the List's look.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: "20 minutes ago". Leave it out to drop the status and time.

props.name: feedback
props.description: The pressed thumb. Pass it with onFeedback to control it, or once to start from it.

props.name: thinking
props.description: The steps the agent ran; shows a collapsed Thinking above an assistant answer.

props.name: thinkingLabel
props.description: The summary on that Thinking header. Defaults to the `thoughtForAMoment` label.

props.name: source
props.description: A page or message the user brought in, shown as a card above their bubble.

props.name: actions
props.description: Feedback, copy and share under an assistant answer. Off while it streams.

props.name: media
props.description: The picture on the left: an Avatar at size 40, an app icon or an image.

props.name: badge
props.description: On the right of the title. A string becomes a small rounded neutral Badge.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Plain cards peeking below it, for a folded group: 0, 1 or 2. Ignored inside a NotificationStack.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button on the top-right corner; called when it is pressed.

props.name: dismissVisibility
props.description: `hover` (default) shows the close button on hover and focus, `always` keeps it on.

props.name: children
props.description: Notifications, newest first, each with a key.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Unfolded from the start and kept unfolded.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How the value reads in the field and to screen readers.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the field.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: How many pages there are.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1.

props.name: getHref
props.description: Each page's URL: pages become links.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one (full layout).

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `previous` label.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `next` label.

props.name: motion
props.description: How the row moves when the page changes.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show the password; leave out to let the button control it.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: body
props.description: Figma's body slot: actions or a small form. Keep it to one task.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the close glyph in the corner.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Called when focus moves into the popover on open; `preventDefault()` keeps it where it was.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press or focus outside the popover; `preventDefault()` keeps it open.

PopoverPanel.description: The popover's panel on its own, in place: no trigger, no positioning. For docs, previews and layers you anchor yourself. The close button calls `onClose`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the panel's root `div`.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the close button is pressed.

props.name: value
props.description: 0 to `max`; left out, the bar is indeterminate.

props.name: showValue
props.description: The percentage at the right of the label row.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How the value reads on the right and to screen readers. Defaults to a whole percentage.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. Pass it with onValueChange to control it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Defaults to the `writeMessage` label.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Files shown as chips above the field; people can remove them before sending.

props.name: model
props.description: The selected model's value (or its label, when there is no `models` list).

props.name: models
props.description: The models menu. Without it the select shows `model` and opens nothing.

props.name: modelIcon
props.description: Icon on the select when `models` doesn't give one.

props.name: actions
props.description: Rows of the + menu. Defaults to Upload a file and Web search, in the `uploadFile` and `webSearch` labels.

props.name: onAddAgent
props.description: The + at the end of the menu's search row.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the text the circle sits on.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

SchedulerRoot.description: The card and its state: put `SchedulerToolbar` and `SchedulerGrid` inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card.

props.name: view
props.description: The view shown.

props.name: views
props.description: The views the switch offers, in order.

props.name: date
props.description: Any moment in the day, week or month shown. Defaults to today.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Called with midnight (in `timeZone`) of the new day as the period changes.

props.name: events
props.description: The events. Leave it out and pass `defaultEvents` to let the Scheduler keep them.

props.name: onEventChange
props.description: After a drag, a resize or a keyboard move: the event with its new times, then as it was.

props.name: onEventOpen
props.description: A click, Enter or Space on an event.

props.name: onSlotSelect
props.description: Slots picked with the pointer or Enter: their start and end, or a whole day.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free or busy times, drawn under the events.

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes per slot: the rows, the drag steps and the keyboard steps.

props.name: workingHours
props.description: From and to, in hours (`[9, 18]`); outside them the grid is bg/canvas.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: An IANA time zone ("Europe/Warsaw"). Defaults to the browser's.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Defaults to `dateLocale`'s.

props.name: now
props.description: Now, for the now line and today. Defaults to the clock, updated every minute.

props.name: eventPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on an event, under its title and time (and attendees).

props.name: slotPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on picked slots, under "New event" and the time.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the popovers and hover cards.

SchedulerToolbar.description: Today, ‹ ›, the period (a button that opens a DatePickerPanel) and the view switch. `children` go before the switch (a "New event" button, a filter). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

SchedulerGrid.description: The current view: day and week as a time grid, month as day cells. A new view crossfades in. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `div` that holds it.

Scheduler.description: The toolbar over the current view. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's root `div`. <Scheduler events={events} onEventChange={(e) => save(e)} onSlotSelect={(slot) => create(slot)} timeZone="Europe/Warsaw" />

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Show the ⌘K keycaps and listen for the shortcut.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Listen for ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Defaults to `shortcut`; turn it off when something else owns the shortcut (a Command menu this bar opens) but the keycaps should still show.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer field; `className` styles the input.

props.name: variant
props.description: `field`: the 32px bar. `panel`: the search row over its results and a footer of key hints.

props.name: groups
props.description: panel: what can be found, grouped, as in CommandMenu.

props.name: idleText
props.description: panel: shown before anything is typed, e.g. what the search looks through. Without it, every item.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: panel: shown when nothing matches; gets the query. Defaults to the `noResultsFor` label.

props.name: meta
props.description: panel: on the right of the footer, e.g. "59 settings indexed".

props.name: hints
props.description: panel: show the Navigate and Open key hints.

SegmentedControlSegment.description: One segment, for SegmentedControl's children. Takes its size and shape from the control.

props.name: items
props.description: The segments as data. Or leave it out and write them as `SegmentedControlSegment` children.

props.name: children
props.description: The segments as elements, when they need more than a label and an icon (a Badge, a Tooltip around one).

props.name: border
props.description: A 1px border-subtle outline around the track.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required when the segments have no visible text of their own.

FieldChrome.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: action
props.description: On the label's line, at the field's right edge: the smallest button, e.g. Clear.

SelectChevron.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: options
props.description: Options, or titled groups of options.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `select` label ("Select…").

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: A 16px icon before the value. Left out, the picked option's own icon shows there.

props.name: layout
props.description: Row layout of every option: description under the label, or after it.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Option icon size; 20 suits stacked two-line options.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, for a native form submit.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.description: Caps the menu's height in px; past it the list scrolls. Left out, the menu takes the room the window has.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the trigger.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

SelectableCardBody.description: @internal The icon tile and the text of a selectable card.

props.name: label
props.description: A word in the middle of a horizontal rule.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional element that opens the sheet (rendered with `asChild`, so pass a Button).

props.name: footer
props.description: The buttons at the bottom. Wrap one in `SheetClose` to make it close the sheet.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal blocks the page and shows the overlay; turn it off for inline previews.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

Sidebar.description: The navigation landmark. Name it with `aria-label` when a page has more than one nav.

props.name: active
props.description: The current page. Sets `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: count
props.description: Unread or pending work. Hidden at 0.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: The collapsed rail: icon only, label in a tooltip.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your router's link instead of `<a>`.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items the group holds.

props.name: triggerProps
props.description: Forwarded to the header button, e.g. `data-force="hover"` on a state sheet.

props.name: children
props.description: Its `SidebarSubItem`s; they sit 12px further in.

props.name: active
props.description: One of its sub-items is the current page: opens it by default and marks the label.

props.name: value
props.description: A number, or a `[from, to]` pair for a range.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change while it moves. Gets a number or a pair, as given.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Once, when a drag ends or a key or a typed value changes it.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: Smallest gap between the range's thumbs, in steps.

props.name: showValue
props.description: The picked value at the right of the label's line. Hidden while `inputs` are on.

props.name: inputs
props.description: Small number fields beside the track to type the value.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: The value in a bubble over the thumb while it moves.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How a value reads in the readout, the bubble, the fields' neighbours and to screen readers.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, for a native form submit.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the slider when there is no `label`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: What's loading, for screen readers. `null` hides the spinner from them.

props.name: menu
props.description: The related actions: `DropdownMenuItem`s, optionally in `DropdownMenuGroup`s.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the arrow.

props.name: menuProps
props.description: Passed to the DropdownMenu: `align` (default `end`), `side`, `open`, `onOpenChange`…

props.name: groupClassName
props.description: Class names for the group around both halves.

props.name: text
props.description: Everything received so far. Grow it as chunks arrive.

props.name: streaming
props.description: More is coming: keeps the caret and the pace going.

props.name: speed
props.description: Letters written a second at the even pace.

props.name: caret
props.description: The caret at the end while it writes.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once everything received is written and `streaming` is off.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the new sort; rows are sorted by value unless `manualSort` is set.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Leave rows in the order given (sort them yourself in onSortChange).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the table.

props.name: rowLabel
props.description: Names a row for its select checkbox ("Select Acme Corp" instead of "Select row 3"), e.g. `(row) => row.name`. `index` is the row's place as shown, from 0. Without it the checkbox says the row's number, which changes when the table is sorted.

props.name: renderCell
props.type: (cell: { row: R; column: Column<R>; index: number; content: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws every body cell's content, after the column's own `cell`: `content` is what the cell would show. Wrap it (a link to the row's page), or replace it; the cell keeps its padding, alignment and truncation.

props.name: renderRow
props.type: (row: { row: R; index: number; selected: boolean; rowProps: React.ComponentProps<'tr'>; children: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws each body row. Spread `rowProps` (state and styles) on your `<tr>` and put `children` (the cells) inside, to add a handler, a data attribute or a context provider: `renderRow={({ row, rowProps, children }) => <tr {...rowProps} onClick={() => open(row)}>{children}</tr>}`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every tab.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

props.name: children
props.description: `TabsContent` panels, one per item value.

TabsContent.description: The panel for one tab value.

props.name: optional
props.description: Adds a muted "(Optional)" after the label: the `optional` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Shows a `length/maxLength` counter.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint row). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

props.name: state
props.description: collapsed once the agent is done, expanded when people open it.

props.name: label
props.description: The summary, e.g. "Thought for 2m 45s". Defaults to the `thought` label ("Thought").

props.name: indicator
props.description: The mark beside the summary.

Toast.description: A single toast on its own. Lives inside `<Toaster>` (it needs the Radix toast provider).

props.name: details
props.description: Under the toast's row, aligned with its text: a list, a progress bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the viewport; `absolute` instead of `fixed` keeps it inside a positioned parent.

props.name: limit
props.description: Most toasts on screen at once; the rest wait behind.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own controlled `<Toast>`s, rendered alongside the ones from `toast()`.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16px icon before the label, or the only content when `iconOnly` (then pass an aria-label).

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

props.name: label
props.description: The action, in one or two words.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys that run the action, e.g. "⌘K" or "⌃⇧V".

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in ms before it opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long it stays after the pointer leaves, in ms, so a quick slip off the trigger doesn't flicker it.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. It must be focusable (a button, a link).

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.
